BBK Direct Status & Stock Sync
code:
<?php
/**
 * BBK DIRECT STATUS & STOCK SYNC ENDPOINT
 */
if (!function_exists('bbk_otomasi_update_status_instant')) {
    function bbk_otomasi_update_status_instant($request) {
        if (!class_exists('WooCommerce')) {
            return new WP_REST_Response(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'WooCommerce tidak aktif'], 500);
        }

        $params = $request->get_json_params();
        $sku = isset($params['sku']) ? sanitize_text_field($params['sku']) : '';
        $status = isset($params['status']) ? sanitize_text_field($params['status']) : 'READY';
        $product_id = isset($params['product_id']) ? intval($params['product_id']) : 0;

        // Cari ID produk berdasarkan SKU jika product_id belum ada
        if (!$product_id && !empty($sku)) {
            $product_id = wc_get_product_id_by_sku($sku);
        }

        if (!$product_id) {
            return new WP_REST_Response(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Produk tidak ditemukan'], 404);
        }

        $stock_status = ($status === 'SOLD') ? 'outofstock' : 'instock';

        // 1. Update Stok WooCommerce
        $product = wc_get_product($product_id);
        if ($product) {
            $product->set_stock_status($stock_status);
            $product->save();
        }

        update_post_meta($product_id, '_stock_status', $stock_status);
        wp_set_object_terms($product_id, $stock_status, 'product_visibility', false);

        // 2. Update Custom Field ACF status_unit
        if (function_exists('update_field')) {
            update_field('status_unit', $status, $product_id);
        } else {
            update_post_meta($product_id, 'status_unit', $status);
        }

        // 3. Purge Cache LiteSpeed Seketika
        if (class_exists('LiteSpeed_Cache_API')) {
            LiteSpeed_Cache_API::purge_url(get_permalink($product_id));
        }

        return new WP_REST_Response([
            'status'       => 'success',
            'product_id'   => $product_id,
            'stock_status' => $stock_status
        ], 200);
    }
}

add_action('rest_api_init', function () {
    register_rest_route('bbk/v1', '/update-status', array(
        'methods'             => 'POST',
        'callback'            => 'bbk_otomasi_update_status_instant',
        'permission_callback' => function ($request) {
            $valid_token = 'BBK_SECRET_KEY_2026_XYZ123';
            $client_token = $request->get_header('x_bbk_secret');
            return ($client_token === $valid_token);
        }
    ));
});
